notes: «حدثنا أبي» (first) and «حدثني أبي» (second) are bare relations: the compiler's father and the father of أحمد بن أبي عمر, neither named in the text
the bracketed «[ة]» is an editor's bracket inside a name, copied as printed
the blessings and «[عليهم السلام]» are left out; Ibn ʿAbbās is the last link, the commentary he gives is the saying
